Rules for every answer:

value.text:
I need to evaluate each claim against the cited evidence. Let me go through each one carefully.

Claim 1: investigator: "Our package NDC 0409-6648-02 is on the FDA shortage list as "Limited Availability" with FDA reason category "Other", manufacturer reports manufacturing delay, next delivery October 2026, estimated recovery December 2026." Cited: [shortage-0409-6648-02]

Evidence: "FDA shortage list: Dextrose Monohydrate 50%, Injection, 25 g/50 mL (NDC 0409-6648-02) from Hospira, Inc., a Pfizer Company; availability: "Limited Availability"; FDA reason category: "Other"; next delivery: October 2026; estimated recovery: December 2026; manufacturer reports: Manufacturing Delay; updated 10/08/2026"

This matches exactly. Supported.

Claim 2: investigator: "Current stock of 440 units covers 23.4 days at 18.8 units per day." Cited: [stock-12]

Evidence: "dextrose DEXTROSE MONOHYDRATE 25 g/50mL (Hospira, Inc., NDC 0409-6648-02, NDA019445): 440 units on hand, 18.8/day over 30 days, 23.4 days of cover"

Matches exactly. Supported.

Claim 3: investigator: "No ongoing recall for this NDC." Cited: [search-recall-12]

Evidence: "Searched this run's FDA ongoing-recall snapshot for our package NDC 0409-6648-02 and product 0409-6648: no ongoing recall."

Matches. Supported.

Claim 4: substitution: "The Orange Book lists 3 therapeutically equivalent application(s) for this product: INTERNATIONAL MEDICATION SYSTEMS LTD ANDA203451 (no current NDC listing at our concentration in a comparable presentation, so it cannot be ordered); OTSUKA ICU MEDICAL LLC NDA018563 (no current NDC listing at our concentration in a comparable presentation, so it cannot be ordered); BAXTER HEALTHCARE CORP NDA020047 (no current NDC listing at our concentration in a comparable presentation, so it cannot be ordered). None can be recommended." Cited: [ob-NDA019445-001, status-ANDA203451, status-NDA018563, status-NDA020047]

Let me check the evidence:

- ob-NDA019445-001: "Orange Book: DEXTROSE 50% 500MG/ML (INJECTABLE;INJECTION) by HOSPIRA INC, application NDA019445, TE code AP (our current product)"

This only shows our current product (NDA019445) has TE code AP. It does NOT list the other three applications (ANDA203451, NDA018563, NDA020047) as therapeutically equivalent. The claim says "The Orange Book lists 3 therapeutically equivalent application(s) for this product" and names three specific applications. But the evidence ob-NDA019445-001 only shows our current product. It doesn't show any other applications.

The other evidence records (status-ANDA203451, status-NDA018563, status-NDA020047) show that these three applications have 0 packages at our concentration in a comparable presentation. But they don't show that the Orange Book lists them as therapeutically equivalent to our product.

The claim makes two assertions:
1. The Orange Book lists 3 therapeutically equivalent applications for this product (naming three specific ones)
2. None have current NDC listing at our concentration in a comparable presentation, so none can be ordered

The second part is supported by the status records. But the first part - that the Orange Book lists these three as therapeutically equivalent - is NOT supported by ob-NDA019445-001. That evidence only shows our current product NDA019445 with TE code AP. It doesn't list any other applications.

So claim 4 is unsupported because the Orange Book evidence cited doesn't list those three applications as therapeutically equivalent. The evidence doesn't show that the Orange Book lists those three as therapeutically equivalent. The status records only show they were checked and have no packages at our concentration.

This is an overstatement/unsupported claim.
